name: request-manager
description: Request Manager - Async HTTP request intermediary with queue management

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/worker && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --workspace=apps/web" "npm run start --workspace=apps/api" "npm run start --workspace=apps/worker"
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.build:worker: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/worker
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
